description:
The initial CTAS sort implementation (ctas-sorted-data-loading) placed apply_ctas_sort()
directly on DuckDBAdapter and used a duck-typed hasattr() check in DataLoader. This works
for DuckDB today, but extending to additional platforms would require copy-pasting the common
lookup/validation/logging logic into each adapter.

This item centralizes apply_ctas_sort() in PlatformAdapter (base class) so that all common
behavior - case-insensitive table lookup, sort column extraction, validate_sql_identifier call,
dry-run capture_sql, success logging, and debug logging on skipped paths - lives in exactly
one place. Each platform adapter overrides only the SQL generation hook
_build_ctas_sort_sql(table_name, sort_columns) -> str | None, returning None if the platform
does not support CTAS-based sorting.

Secondary items in scope:
- Wire tuning_config into the DataLoader calls for ClickHouse, StarRocks, SQLite, and
  MotherDuck (currently they construct DataLoader without tuning_config, so CTAS sort
  never fires even when tuning is enabled).
- Rename the misleadingly named if_not_exists parameter in DuckDBDDLGenerator.generate_ctas_ddl()
  to or_replace (the parameter generates CREATE OR REPLACE, not IF NOT EXISTS).
- Remove or simplify the hasattr(adapter, "apply_ctas_sort") guard in DataLoader now that
  the method is guaranteed by the base class; keep the tuning_config None check as the opt-in.
- Add debug-level logging on all early-return paths in the base apply_ctas_sort() so
  operators can understand why sorting was skipped.

work_units.notes:
Move all logic from DuckDBAdapter.apply_ctas_sort() to PlatformAdapter:
1. Case-insensitive lookup of table_name in tuning_config.table_tunings
2. Extract sort columns via table_tuning.get_columns_by_type(TuningType.SORTING)
3. If no sort columns: log_debug("No sort columns for {table} - skipping CTAS sort") and return False
4. Call self._build_ctas_sort_sql(validated_table, sort_columns)
5. If None returned: log_debug("{platform} does not support CTAS sort - skipping") and return False
6. Dry-run path: self.capture_sql(sql, "ctas_sort", validated_table); return True
7. Execute sql via connection
8. self.log_verbose("Applied CTAS sorting to {table_name}: {col_names}")
9. Return True
work_units.summary: Implement centralized apply_ctas_sort() in PlatformAdapter with all common logic
